head_commit.message:
feat(kernel): bind G1-a CPU owner revisions and lifetime fencing

Keep CPU accounting and native revision metadata under the original IRQ-safe owner lock; fence replaced and deleted owners without discarding retained final charges. Preserve the original upstream lock seed and derive only the local os-control working-lock edge, with locked component metadata resolution.

Add a clean-source ordinary-product QueryAbi candidate runner, exact marker output, four explicitly unsupported operation checks, module development documentation, and normal A06 CI evidence retention. Native grants, resource effects, durable Hepta K/D, device control, and full G1/G2 remain unqualified.
